baseline_note: PR #238 head (main e153f86 plus the test-name fix). No search on these packs ran before this file.
scope: 20 new questions on five packs that no earlier trial used: julia, Nim, deno, fsharp and perl5. The packs use the pinned commits of eval/quality/workflows.yaml from the local clones, with the include list widened to the test folders.

selection.method: Eligible files match the pack's test folder prefix and file-name pattern, count as tests under is_test_path, and are not runner or helper files (runtests, choosetests, testenv, testdefs, helper, utils, testfx, Program.fs, common, setup), and contain a test case marker of the language (julia @test, Nim doAssert/check/assert, Deno.test, F# [<Fact>]/[<Test>]/[<Theory>], Perl ok/is/like at line start). Sort, shuffle with random.Random(seed + pack), and take the first three from distinct parent folders. If a pack has fewer than three such folders, take the next files in shuffle order. If a drafter finds no implementation for a drawn file inside the pack, the next eligible file in the shuffle order replaces it, and the record keeps the reason.
selection.correction: The first draw (selection-initial.json) counted julia test/testhelpers/Quaternions.jl and a fixture package file test/project/.../ExtDep2.jl. These hold no test case. The rule now also needs a test case marker. The correction came before any question and before any search on these packs.
templates: Where is the test for X?
selection.replacement_rule: A replacement is the next file in the shuffle order after the replaced file that is not chosen, not rejected, and not in a parent folder of the other two chosen files.

replacements.reason: The behaviors in this file are in C (gcext.c, foreignlib.c and the Julia runtime). The pack holds only base/ and test/.
All test cases sit in a disabled #if TUPLE_SAMPLE block and check compiler and .NET behavior, not src/FSharp.Core.

The test cases check a JSON log of exported symbols and a compiled binary. The juliac build script writes that log, and it is not in the pack. The drafter found only a partial match (the custom C name in base/c.jl), so the file is rejected.

queries.query: Which tests cover locating a program on the search path when an earlier directory denies access?

evidence.relevance: Checks the lookup skips the unreadable first directory and returns the program from the second.
Catches the permission-denied error so the search continues with the next directory.
